purpose: Inspect current A1 errors without changing model, rules, parameters, scoring or annotations

frame-index.json.selection: Nine evenly spaced diagnostic rows per window, including first and last; decoded frames selected by zero-based FileFrameSource frame_id.

edge-index.json.description: Specified frame evidence contact sheet; no subjective classification

findings.high_clearance_interpretation: All six show upward flight followed by missing motion and reappearance near the image top; direct near-top exit coordinates exist in A1-01 R2 and A1-04 R4. Not every missing frame was given human ball-location truth.

gap_duration_conflict.note: One gap-length threshold alone cannot preserve the former while separating the latter with the other grouping rules unchanged.

findings.limit_conclusion: Current evidence identifies specific rule and observation limitations, but does not establish an upper bound for trajectory-only approaches or necessity of whole-video processing.
